mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which signals weakening corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO), manufacturing output contraction reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.0% signals strong economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% quarterly, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI index level above 320 (indicating elevated inflation) prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 320, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both employment growth (PAYEMS) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a labor market slowdown that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both PAYEMS and UNRATE decline, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS), monetary tightening reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
